clean_input.description: Whether to remove characters that are not allowed by the Azure resource naming rules (default: true).

error_when_exceeding_max_length.description: When true, returns an error if the generated name exceeds the resource type's maximum length instead of truncating it.

name.description: Base name of the resource. Will be sanitized according to Azure naming rules for the specified resource type.

passthrough.description: When true, the name is returned as-is without applying naming convention logic. Only validation is performed.

prefixes.description: List of prefixes to prepend to the generated name, in order.

random_length.description: Number of random alphanumeric characters to append to the name. Useful for ensuring uniqueness.

random_seed.description: Seed value for random character generation. Set this to produce deterministic names across runs.

resource_type.description: Azure resource type for name generation (e.g., "azurerm_storage_account"). The result is stored in the result attribute.

resource_types.description: List of additional Azure resource types to generate names for. Results are stored in the results map attribute.

result.description: The generated Azure-compliant resource name for the primary resource_type.

results.description: Map of generated names keyed by resource type, for each type specified in resource_types.

separator.description: Separator character used between name components (default: "-").

suffixes.description: List of suffixes to append to the generated name, in order.

use_slug.description: Whether to include the CAF resource type slug/abbreviation in the generated name (default: true).

convention.description: Naming convention to apply. One of: cafclassic, cafrandom, random, passthrough.

max_length.description: Maximum length for the generated name. Defaults to the Azure resource type's maximum.

postfix.description: Postfix to append to the generated name.

prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to the generated name.

prefixes.description: List of prefixes to prepend to the generated name.

suffixes.description: List of suffixes to append to the generated name.

fails_if_empty.description: Throws an error if the environment variable is not set (default: false).
